From 9dae65913b32d05dbc8ff4b8a6bf04a0e49a8eb6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Johan Hovold <johan@kernel.org>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 17:46:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] memory: mtk-smi: fix device leak on larb probe

Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the SMI device
during larb probe on late probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on
driver unbind.

Fixes: cc8bbe1a8312 ("memory: mediatek: Add SMI driver")
Fixes: 038ae37c510f ("memory: mtk-smi: add missing put_device() call in mtk_smi_device_link_common")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org	# 4.6: 038ae37c510f
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org	# 4.6
Cc: Yong Wu <yong.wu@mediatek.com>
Cc: Miaoqian Lin <linmq006@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Johan Hovold <johan@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251121164624.13685-3-johan@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzk@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/memory/mtk-smi.c b/drivers/memory/mtk-smi.c
index dd6150d200e8..3609bfd3c64b 100644
--- a/drivers/memory/mtk-smi.c
+++ b/drivers/memory/mtk-smi.c
@@ -685,6 +685,7 @@ static void mtk_smi_larb_remove(struct platform_device *pdev)
 	device_link_remove(&pdev->dev, larb->smi_common_dev);
 	pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);
 	component_del(&pdev->dev, &mtk_smi_larb_component_ops);
+	put_device(larb->smi_common_dev);
 }
 
 static int __maybe_unused mtk_smi_larb_resume(struct device *dev)
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of the Patch

#### Modifications in Each File

**`drivers/memory/mtk-smi.c`**  
- In the function `mtk_smi_larb_remove()`, added a call to `put_device(larb->smi_common_dev);` after `component_del()`.

#### Relationships Between the Modifications

- The added `put_device()` call releases a reference taken earlier during the larb probe (not shown in this patch) via `get_device()` or similar.  
- Previously, this reference was only released in the probe error path (added by commit `038ae37c510f`) but was missing in the normal removal path (`mtk_smi_larb_remove`) and on late probe failures that lead to removal.  
- This causes a device reference leak when the larb driver is unbound or when probe is deferred after obtaining the reference.  
- The fix completes the reference management by ensuring `put_device()` is also called during device removal, making it symmetric with the probe path.

Here is the commit message:
memory: mtk-smi: fix device leak on larb probe

Make sure to drop the reference taken when looking up the SMI device
during larb probe on late probe failure (e.g. probe deferral) and on
driver unbind.

Fixes: cc8bbe1a8312 ("memory: mediatek: Add SMI driver")
Fixes: 038ae37c510f ("memory: mtk-smi: add missing put_device() call in mtk_smi_device_link_common")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org	# 4.6: 038ae37c510f
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org	# 4.6
Cc: Yong Wu <yong.wu@mediatek.com>
Cc: Miaoqian Lin <linmq006@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Johan Hovold <johan@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20251121164624.13685-3-johan@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kozlowski <krzk@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The `mtk_smi_larb_probe` function acquires a reference to `smi_common_dev` (via `get_device()` or equivalent) but the corresponding `put_device()` is missing in the `mtk_smi_larb_remove` function and on late probe failure paths (e.g., probe deferral). This causes a device reference leak when the larb driver is unbound or when probe defers after the reference has been taken.

Here is the patch:
 
 static void mtk_smi_larb_remove(struct platform_device *pdev)
 {
 	struct mtk_smi_larb *larb = platform_get_drvdata(pdev);
 
 	device_link_remove(&pdev->dev, larb->smi_common_dev);
 	pm_runtime_disable(&pdev->dev);
 	component_del(&pdev->dev, &mtk_smi_larb_component_ops);
+	put_device(larb->smi_common_dev);
 }

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
- In `mtk_smi_larb_probe`: `larb->smi_common_dev` is assigned a device whose reference count is incremented (e.g., via `get_device()` or a function that implicitly takes a reference).
- In `mtk_smi_larb_remove` (original): 
  ```c
  component_del(&pdev->dev, &mtk_smi_larb_component_ops);
  ```
  without a subsequent `put_device(larb->smi_common_dev)`.

Reason: The reference taken during probe is never released in the remove path, causing a device reference leak when the driver is unbound or when probe fails after taking the reference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
- In `mtk_smi_larb_remove` (patched):
  ```c
  component_del(&pdev->dev, &mtk_smi_larb_component_ops);
  put_device(larb->smi_common_dev);
  ```

Reason: Adding `put_device(larb->smi_common_dev)` after `component_del` ensures the reference acquired during probe is properly released when the driver is removed, thus fixing the device reference leak.
